$comment: Maturity: v1alpha1, may break with a changelog entry in api/README.md (ADR 0027). The one ticket rule: the api's intake (rl-domain), the Session CRD (deployments/helm/rangelight/files/crds/session.yaml) and the lane's /etc/rangelight/ticket.json are tested against this file. ADRs: 0045, 0051.
title: Rangelight ticket v1alpha1
description: The ticket a session works on: the lane's brief and its acceptance criteria (ADR 0045 §3). The runner mounts it in the lane as /etc/rangelight/ticket.json.

key.description: The tracker's key, for example RAN-35. The lane namespace is rl-<key, lowercased>, so it stays a DNS label.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria, AC1..ACn in order.
